question: What is the biosynthetic route of terpenes in plants ?:

options.opa: They are synthesized by the mevalonic acid route or by the fatty acid route.
options.opb: They are synthesized by the mevalonic acid route or by the deoxy-xylulose phosphate (DOXP) pathway also called GAP / Pyruvate.
options.opc: They are synthesized by the mevalonic route and the sikimico route.
options.opd: They are synthesized by the sikimic acid route or by the deoxy-xylulose phosphate (DOXP) pathway also called GAP / Pyruvate.
options.ope: They are synthesized by the polyacetate route.
